text:
hana_mkt: Preflight for next Tue partner webinar  ticket: final checks on reg page localization, Zoom recording tracks, and post-event replay routing. Quick confirm owners?

tomas_ops: I'll own Zoom config + recordings. Plan: webinar mode, cloud record (mp4), produce separate audio tracks for presenters + interpreters, enable auto-transcript, and turn on 'recording disclaimer' popup for EEA attendees. Retention: NA=90d, EMEA=30d, APAC=60d.

izzy_growth: Reg pages: we need localized variants (en/us, en/uk, es, pt, zh). I'll create per-locale copy + a time auto-render snippet. Add field: "region_timezone" -> used to render local time. Also add opt-in for partner follow-up.

olga_access: Accessibility: automated captions are fine for draft but we must store human-reviewed SRTs for public replay. Provide alt text for each slide and a text-mode replay page. Also ensure color contrast on localized pages.

sam_intl: Partner ask: Nimbus wants co-branded replay gated for 72h before public drop. They require partner_consent checkbox on the reg form and a mapping in HS property `partner_consent=true`. Also ask: can we include a partner CTA in the T+24h email?

hana_mkt: Yes to gating. We'll do private replay for 72h then public with redacted SRTs. Sam, please confirm partner CTA copy by EOD.

tomas_ops: Zoom bot: configuring RTMP fallback and separate audio tracks. Also enabling per-region watermarking on replay (email watermark for EMEA).

zoom-bot: Zoom meeting created. Meeting ID: 765432100. Cloud recording: enabled. Auto-transcription: enabled. RTMP fallback configured.

izzy_growth: Lead routing: registrant -> Clearbit enrich -> HS upsert -> property: region/local_lang/partner_consent/interest_area. Routing rules: NA->AE-NA, EMEA->AE-EMEA, APAC->AE-APAC. Partner_consent=true -> add to "partner_nurture" list.

hana_mkt: Post-event timeline:
- T+2h: internal MP4 + raw SRT -> s3://redwood-marketing/temp/{event-date}/ (ops uploads)
- T+6h: PII scrub run on transcript (owner: hana_mkt) and partner signoff for gated replay (owner: sam_intl)
- T+12h: clips (3x highlights) auto-generated + manual QC (owner: izzy_growth)
- T+24h: gated replay page goes live for registrants + partner list; public release at T+72h after PII signoff

olga_access: PII scrub must include removing direct identifiers in transcripts and checking images/slides for embedded emails or keys. I'll provide a checklist.

tomas_ops: Export script for eng ops:

```
# download + scrub + upload
zoomcli download --meeting 765432100 --out master.mp4 --transcript master.srt
pii-scrub --in master.srt --out scrubbed.srt --rules pii_patterns.txt
clipper --src master.mp4 --markers scrubbed.srt --out clips/
aws s3 cp master.mp4 s3://redwood-marketing/private/{event-date}/master.mp4
aws s3 cp scrubbed.srt s3://redwood-marketing/private/{event-date}/master.srt
```

izzy_growth: Reminder: add utm template on reg pages: ?utm_source={channel}&utm_campaign=partner_webinar_may. Also schedule reminder emails (48h, 1h). Create two subject lines for A/B test.

hana_mkt: Who monitors chat and who confirms the recording link within 90 min after the event?

izzy_growth: I'll monitor chat + collect interest flags. Tomas will confirm recording link and start the export.

sam_intl: Partner notes: Nimbus wants a co-branded one-pager attached to the gated replay email. I'll sync with design and drop final asset link here.

olga_access: After clips are created, I'll QA captions and alt-text before public release.

hana_mkt: Last checklist: confirm regional retention applied in Zoom admin, set recording retention windows, and ensure the partnership opt-in mapping is present in HS. Everything else green?

tomas_ops: Done (retention & watermark set).

zoom-bot: Reminder: webinar starts in 24 hours. Hosts: hana_mkt. Co-hosts: tomas_ops, izzy_growth.

hana_mkt: Thanks team  owners recap: @tomas_ops (zoom + export), @izzy_growth (reg pages + chat + clips QC), @olga_access (PII QA + accessibility), @sam_intl (partner assets + gating). See you in rehearsal. :white_check_mark:
